_meta.what: Gravity's year-one content plan for Ragnarok Zero Global, month by month.
_meta.rule: A plan, not a promise. It names months, never dates, and the months are the ones the source printed. Nothing here is moved, merged or translated into a guess; an item only leaves the plan list when one of our own patch pages shows it live.
_meta.source: UnGeek, 'Gravity reveals Ragnarok Zero Global year one roadmap ahead of its official launch', 14 Aug 2026 — https://www.ungeek.ph/2026/08/gravity-reveals-ragnarok-zero-global-year-one-roadmap-ahead-of-its-official-launch/
_meta.caution: The source does not say whether the plan may change, and it reports a global roadmap; the Thai service can differ.
